independent_findings: Four original operative commands: board establishment/investigation, member disqualification, reporting, and maintaining conditions.
The 30-day reporting deadline is not an observed report date or express termination of the board.

Section 1-103 expressly runs through 30 days after the board actually reports. Its agreement exception permits changes by agreement; the mere possibility of an agreement is not a whole-order end or proof that the board dissolved.

EO12379 section 6 formally revokes EO12159 on 1982-08-17; the complete revoker has no delayed effective clause or target-specific savings. Its inactive-or-no-longer-necessary preamble supports treating this as formal cleanup, not proof of first cessation.

The original expressly invokes Railway Labor Act section 10 (45 USC 160). The controlling statutory text and historical amendments were not independently read from a held statutory source. The EO quote alone is insufficient to decide independently authorized statutory effects.
No actual report, agreement, or earlier operative cessation was established in the bounded held searches. Keep first-end dates unknown rather than infer them from a deadline or later cleanup.
